headline: NHTSA sets 34.9 mpg fleet average by 2031
deck: The department estimates the new CAFE standards at 34.9 miles per gallon in model year 2031, up from 30.1 in 2024.
body: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration estimates that its new corporate average fuel-economy standards would achieve a fleet average of **34.9 miles per gallon** by model year 2031, up from **30.1 miles per gallon** for model year 2024. [E1]
Ars Technica, reporting the same final, puts the new goal at 34.9 mpg by model year 2031. [E2]
